name: IBM Bob
description: Assists enterprise developers with an agentic IDE and the Bob Shell CLI that plan, write, refactor and document code, run commands, and plug into CI/CD pipelines.

skills.name: Agent, Ask and Plan Modes
skills.description: Switches between autonomous editing, codebase Q&A without changes, and planning before implementation.

skills.name: Non-Interactive Bob Shell
skills.description: Runs Bob tasks from scripts and CI/CD pipelines, authenticated with an API key.

skills.name: Subagents
skills.description: Splits complex tasks into parallel subagents in focused modes, each approved before it starts.

skills.name: MCP Tools
skills.description: Connects local or remote MCP servers to give Bob access to databases, APIs and internal systems.
